harness_revision_note: Pins the commit that adds the v6 five-framework manifest and the verl/OpenRLHF/NeMo-RL adapters on top of shootout protocol v5.
prewarm_command: python benchmarks/adapters/framework_envs.py --execute && python -c "from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer; from datasets import load_dataset; AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct', revision='989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306'); AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct', revision='989aa7980e4cf806f80c7fef2b1adb7bc71aa306'); load_dataset('openai/gsm8k', 'main', revision='740312add88f781978c0658806c59bc2815b9866')"
shootout_manifest_hardware_note: L40S 48GB; 5 frameworks x 3 seeds = 15 runs at 1.5B/200 steps. Per-run time is unmeasured for v4/v5; see benchmarks/README.md for the planning estimate.
